notes: Adhyaya XXI gives one unconditional reading for every sub-period of every dasha. Only the three pairs missing from the damaged BPHS scan (Mercury-Mercury, Mercury-Saturn, Venus-Saturn) are encoded here; BPHS ch. 54-62 cover the other 78 with conditions.

skipped.reason: Covered with conditions by BPHS ch. 54-62; Phaladeepika's versions are largely diseases and deaths.

rules.text: Mercury-Mercury: devotion to virtue, the company of learned people, a clear and unbiased mind, money through scholars, great fame through learning and continuous happiness.
Mercury-Saturn: heavy loss of wealth and of good standing, and setbacks across business.
Venus-Saturn: honour from civic, military or government figures, a fine partner, and an inflow of money, goods and comforts.
